panels.text: The chamber shows alternating periods of testing (showing a pattern) and resting (a blank screen). After each test, the brightness of the pattern will be darkened based on how often the mouse exhibited OMR.

This is called a "trial". Each trial consists of a sequence of multiple test and rest periods, and the difficulty scaling can be customized for each trial. The trial ends once the mouse shows 0 signs of OMR.
